qa.question: Should Roulet 12 and 13 have a federal EIA record yet?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists no planned Oklahoma units at Anadarko plant 3006. The Oklahoma permit memorandum and trade press do describe the two turbines.
qa.recommendation: Leave both units as construction and recheck the next EIA monthly table due November 24, 2026.
qa.note: I read the Southwest Power Pool open queue list on 5 November 2026 (https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GenerateActiveCSV). Entry GEN-2023-GR1 is a replacement request of 97.488 MW of gas at the Anadarko 69 kV plant connection, owned by the cooperative, with commercial operation shown as December 2025 and a cessation date of November 2025. Its size fits the two new 50.2 MW turbines, so it is not a third project. Its dates are earlier than the late 2026 completion reported in the press, and I found no report that the turbines are running. Entries GEN-2007-052 at 150 MW and GEN-2005-022 at 177 MW are older plants already in commercial operation and match existing units.
